svg.title: A better approach — aligned schemas
svg.desc: The focused row moves down the master schema and its two aligned source schemas. It starts at Expiration date, then New-renewal, Insured name, Street address, City, State and Zip, before continuing from Line of Business. Blank source cells indicate missing mappings. Benefits: clear relationship between source and master items; scales across dozens of schemas.

g.text: Clear relationship between source and master items
